title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: Standard or Advanced categorisation and automatic data preparation
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, automatic preparation workflow, categorisation choices, billing and permissions are supported by Microsoft's documentation. The documented controls are accurate, and targeted searches found no automation or tenant-wide categorisation restriction contradicting the reported gaps.

claims.claim: This Microsoft Purview change adds Standard or Advanced categorisation and automatic preparation of investigation data for AI.
claims.quote: including the ability to choose between a standard categorization for potential time and/or cost savings or a more advanced categorization to include AI-generated topics.
